title: BOFT butterfly bank with Mirror task addresses
hypothesis: A shared butterfly angle vector plus task addresses represents aligned orthogonal task transforms at lower bytes than independent BOFT; simple rank-one parameter factorization may match exactly.
physical_object: One frozen 8x8 linear block with three butterfly stages
mirror_coordinate: Six scalar task addresses applied to one shared 12-angle butterfly template
controls: ordinary factorized task-code x shared-angle template

development.selection_metric: MSE, bytes, orthogonality/cycle error, transform time

optimization.fit: post-fit least squares and nonlinear least squares over BOFT angles

storage.serializer: uncompressed NumPy NPZ; equivalent factor controls use identical packed state
paid_objects: shared angle vector and task codes

compute.active_compute_proxy: butterfly stage applications plus W projection

success_gate: At least 3/4 fresh aligned: Mirror within 1.10x independent BOFT MSE, <=80% bytes, geometry errors <1e-10, and lower bytes than simple factorized-angle control.
failure_gate: No byte-quality Pareto improvement over simple factorized-angle control or >1.25x independent BOFT MSE on >=3/4.
accounting_amendment: Roundtrip test found factorized control returned pre-optimization initial coordinates while evaluated outputs used optimized coordinates. Preserve original fresh rows as invalid, return optimized state, and use new audit seeds 163/269/367/463.
